PURCHASE ORDER FOR SERVICES

Purchase Order Number: BW-2026-0417

Date: April 17, 2026

Buyer: Brightwater Bakery Supply LLC, 77 Mill Street, Bend, Oregon 97701

Seller: Corvane Signworks LLC, 1810 Basalt Road, Redmond, Oregon 97756

1. SCOPE OF WORK

1.1 Seller shall design, fabricate and install one exterior storefront sign for Buyer's retail location at 77 Mill Street, Bend, Oregon.

1.2 The sign shall be a single-sided, internally lit aluminum cabinet measuring eight (8) feet wide by three (3) feet high, displaying the words "Brightwater Bakery Supply" in the colors shown on the proof approved by Buyer.

1.3 Seller shall provide Buyer with two (2) design proofs, and Buyer shall approve one proof in writing before fabrication begins.

1.4 Installation includes mounting hardware, electrical connection to the existing circuit at the storefront, and removal of the old sign.

2. PRICE

2.1 The total price for all work under this Purchase Order is $6,850, which includes design, materials, fabrication, delivery, installation and removal of the old sign.

2.2 The price is fixed and shall not change unless Buyer requests a change to the work in writing and both parties sign a written change describing the new price.

2.3 Seller is responsible for obtaining any sign permit required by the City of Bend, and the permit fee is included in the total price.

3. PAYMENT

3.1 Buyer shall pay a deposit of $2,000 within seven (7) days after Buyer approves the design proof.

3.2 Seller shall invoice Buyer for the remaining balance of $4,850 after installation is complete.

3.3 Buyer shall pay the remaining balance within thirty (30) days after receiving Seller's invoice.

3.4 Payment shall be made by check or bank transfer to the account named on Seller's invoice.

4. SCHEDULE AND DELIVERY

4.1 Seller shall complete installation no later than June 15, 2026.

4.2 Seller shall give Buyer at least three (3) business days' notice of the installation date so that Buyer can arrange access to the storefront.

4.3 Installation shall take place outside Buyer's business hours of 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., unless Buyer agrees otherwise.

4.4 If Seller cannot complete installation by the date in Section 4.1, Seller shall tell Buyer as soon as Seller knows of the delay and shall propose a new date.

5. WARRANTY

5.1 Seller warrants that the sign will be free from defects in materials and workmanship for two (2) years after installation.

5.2 Seller warrants the LED lighting components for five (5) years after installation.

5.3 During the warranty period, Seller shall repair or replace any defective part at no cost to Buyer, including labor.

5.4 The warranty does not cover damage caused by vandalism, accident, storms or changes to the sign made by anyone other than Seller.

6. INSURANCE AND SITE CARE

6.1 Seller shall carry general liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence while performing work at Buyer's location.

6.2 Seller shall repair any damage to the building facade caused by the installation or by removal of the old sign.

6.3 Seller shall remove all debris and packaging from the site when installation is complete.

7. OWNERSHIP

7.1 Title to the sign passes to Buyer when Buyer pays the remaining balance in full.

7.2 Buyer may use the approved design on its website, packaging and other materials without further payment to Seller.

8. GENERAL

8.1 This Purchase Order is the complete agreement between Buyer and Seller for this work.

8.2 Any change to this Purchase Order must be in writing and signed by both parties.

8.3 This Purchase Order is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon.

Approved for Buyer: Rosa Delgado, Owner, Brightwater Bakery Supply LLC

Accepted for Seller: Marcus Ibarra, Managing Member, Corvane Signworks LLC
